system:
You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude, running in a Linux workspace. Use the Bash tool for commands and the Read and Edit tools for files. Keep diffs minimal and leave the test suite green.

Repository: /workspace/widget. Build with cargo. Do not modify vendored sources. Ask before destructive commands.

content.text: The loopback relay drops the final SSE event when the upstream connection closes without a trailing blank line. Fix the stream forwarder so the last frame is flushed, and add a regression test that uses a chunked upstream response. Keep the change small.
I will inspect the stream forwarder first, then add a bounded regression test around the final flush.
Also confirm the behavior when the client disconnects mid-stream. Report the exact files you changed.
